video_title: Ron Harper Jr. says watching his brother, Dylan, play in the Finals was a 'special moment' ❤️ | SC

quotes.speaker: Ron Harper Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Ron Harper Jr. on watching his brother Dylan in the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: being able to watch Dylan live out his dreams and be able to be effective on the biggest stage
quotes.quote: It was great, man. Just being able to watch Dylan live out his dreams and be able to be effective on the biggest stage out there, it was just a really special moment. I was in my apartment wearing my Dylan Harper shirt, rooting for him, and going crazy every time he did something. He had a great night, played really well, and he made history.

quotes.speaker: Scott Van Pelt
quotes.summary_phrase: Ron Harper Jr. discusses his ongoing communication with brother Dylan
quotes.excerpt: Me and Dylan talk every day, whether it's a FaceTime call, text message, we're in a bunch of group chats

text_blocks.speaker: Scott Van Pelt
text_blocks.text: I was thinking about it, wondering when's the last time you texted with him or spoke with him?

text_blocks.speaker: Ron Harper Jr.
text_blocks.text: Me and Dylan talk every day, whether it's a FaceTime call, text message, we're in a bunch of group chats together, but we talk all the time, every day. Pretty much after every game, so we're always there for each other, just talking about whatever.

quotes.speaker: Ron Harper Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Ron Harper Jr. on the Spurs' potential to bounce back in the series
quotes.excerpt: it's a long series. They would have loved to come out with a win, but first game, no need to overreact
quotes.quote: It's a long series. They would have loved to come out with a win, but first game, no need to overreact. I feel like as a team, they played well, but they had things they could do better on, and Dylan felt the same way. They're just going to try to go out there and execute where they came short last night.

quotes.speaker: Ron Harper Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Ron Harper Jr. on moving past his childhood Knicks fandom
quotes.excerpt: I tried to be as unbiased as possible when it came to the Knicks and I kind of had to let that part of my childhood go
quotes.quote: For me, it stopped as soon as I started doing the draft process. I tried to be as unbiased as possible when it came to the Knicks and I kind of had to let that part of my childhood go. Ironically enough, now I play for the Celtics. I grew up not liking the Celtics, liking the Knicks, so it's just funny how that always goes around.

quotes.speaker: Ron Harper Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Ron Harper Jr. describes Victor Wembanyama's unique impact on the court
quotes.excerpt: he's a great player. He's one of one, and just like I'm watching the game last night, he just affects the game
quotes.quote: It's indescribable almost. He's a great player. He's one of one, and just like I'm watching the game last night, he just affects the game in so many different ways, whether it's on offense or defense. He's just really effective in everything he does out there, and the Spurs are very lucky to have him, you know, him along with Dylan. It's going to be exciting for a long time to come with them two playing together.

quotes.speaker: Ron Harper Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Ron Harper Jr. on Jalen Brunson's toughness and skill
quotes.excerpt: he knows how to get to his spots. He plays with a lot of deception, and you kind of never know what he's going to do next
quotes.quote: He's a great player. He knows how to get to his spots. He plays with a lot of deception, and you kind of never know what he's going to do next, but he's one of the toughest guards in the league and he's one of the best players in the league, and you know, he showed that last night.
